"Shared by all" strip: the grid shows only what differs

Before: Frontend, Backend and Ships via said the same thing on all 10 web apps, and the RL table repeated Hosting and AI on all 9. After: those columns become one line above each table, and the grid keeps only the columns where apps differ.

What moved

  1. STRIP A "Shared by all N" line sits at the top of each table's card, outside the sideways scroller so it stays put. The web table shows Frontend Blazor WASM · Backend ASP.NET Core · Ships via GitHub Actions; the RL table shows Hosting Static Web Apps · AI Reinforcement-learning agents.
  2. AUTO It's worked out from the data on every load, per table. A value moves up only when it's identical in every app; for AI, the whole list of services must match. The day one app changes backend, its column comes back.
  3. EXTRAS A new Extras column keeps what the shared Backend hid: SignalR (PoFightJudge), GitHub API (PoRepoLineTracker), Google Maps API (PoTraffic), Azure email (PoWatch), Google Places API (PoSeeReview).
  4. HINT Strip values keep their hint when every app agrees on the detail too, for example "ASP.NET Core on .NET 10".
